steps: Here is the Agent S D K in action. Your app calls query just once, passing a prompt and options: the Glob, Grep and Read tools, and a maximum of eight turns.
The S D K sends the messages and tool definitions to Claude, and Claude replies with a tool use block, asking to glob the contract text files first.
Now pause. On the plain Messages A P I, your own code would have to detect that tool use, run it, return the result, and loop, over and over.
Instead, the S D K runs it for you. It checks hooks, deny rules, allow rules and the can use tool callback, then runs Glob and gets the matching files. Your app writes no loop code.
The tool result is appended and the loop repeats. On turn two of a maximum eight, Claude asks for Grep, searching for twenty twenty-six renewals.
Grep runs, its result goes back, and this time Claude answers in plain text with no tool call: it found two contracts renewing in twenty twenty-six. No tool use means the loop stops.
Finally, the loop ends and a result message reaches your app, showing two turns, a cost of about six tenths of a cent, and session one. One call, the whole loop handled.
